title: Wastewater genomic surveillance reveals influenza A H3N2 subclade K during early season influenza activity, Colorado, 2025 - 2026 influenza season
description: We performed tiled amplicon sequencing targeting the Hemagglutinin (HA) gene segment for Influenza A subtype H3 using a custom primer scheme on samples collected from wastewater utilities within Colorado's sentinel surveillance system with collection dates between September 1, 2025 to February 14, 2026.
